assumptions: Every conclusion is uniform only on the full inherited root bracket 1 and one displayed real lambda box at a time; root uniqueness is not assumed.
The pinned actual-family theorem and scalar invariant barrier are used only while x>=xs>3, so the Riccati chart is node-free on Q_switch<=Q<=4.
The exact linear propagator includes both 2*rho and rho/x. The remaining nonlinear integral is bounded only by 0<=rho^2<=1, without sampling an approximate trajectory.
Finite kernel panels bound monotone denominators while integrating exp(-2y) exactly; the unbounded positive tail is added analytically and is not a numerical quadrature call.
The downstream state is scale-free at Q_switch. A width certificate does not determine the sign of Gamma_1, establish a zero, continue a root, or construct spectral or RAQ data.

declared_conventions.compact_partition: 16 exact-rational backward Q steps h=-11/160 from Q_switch=-29/10 to Q_0=-4.
declared_conventions.execution: SymPy exact identities plus python-flint Arb analytic kernel panels, interval Taylor and Bessel regressions; no SciPy ODE, quadrature, root, finite difference or sampling grid
declared_conventions.minus_tail: The pinned rotating-frame Volterra masses enclose the complete Q<-4 quotient correction.
declared_conventions.plus_normalization: For each fixed real parameter, positively rescale the actual DLMF recessive solution so u_lambda(4)=A_lambda(4)^(-1/4); only its logarithmic direction is transported to Q_switch.
declared_conventions.riccati_frame: r=-u_Q/u=x+1/2+rho on x>=3, with rho in [-1,1] from the pinned invariant barrier.
declared_conventions.scale_free_characteristic: g_lambda=Gamma_1(v)/v(-4), formed only after the final amplitude interval excludes zero.

exact_checks.statement: The Q and x forms of the raw-C coefficient agree.
r=-u_Q/u and rho=r-x-1/2 obey the declared Q-Riccati equation.
The x-Riccati equation is the exact Q equation divided by x.
M(x,t)=exp(2(x-t))*x/t is the exact propagator of rho_x=(2+1/x)rho.
The constant-forcing kernel becomes the displayed positive y-integrand.
The lambda-forcing kernel becomes the displayed positive y-integrand.
Equal-parameter Riccati directions obey the exact projective difference law.
The Riccati vector field has the displayed direction derivative.
For rho in [-1,1] and x>=3, 2+(1+2rho)/x is at least 5/3, so backward x transport contracts equal-parameter directions.
The complete Q<-4 potential mass is exact.
The complete Q<-4 forcing mass is exact.
Sixteen exact steps join Q_switch=-29/10 to Q0=-4.
The configured root bracket is exactly the pinned root-1 sign-changing Bessel bracket.
The sharp calculation is bound to the pinned actual normalization, parameter boxes and x>=3 invariant barrier.
The downstream quotient uses the pinned Gamma_1 boundary identity at the same Q0.
The reused downstream map is tied to the audited six finite tiers and six width failures from the full [-1,1] switch direction.
The exact root-1 bracket lies in (2,3).
The two lambda-zero tiers make exactly six switch and six endpoint Bessel calls.

primary_sources.used_for: the inherited actual recessive direction and Q=4 log-slope enclosure

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified-Bessel equation and recurrences, sections 10.25 and 10.29
primary_sources.used_for: the exact lambda-zero switch and endpoint inclusion regressions

primary_sources.not_used_for: a black-box ODE theorem; the contraction kernel bounds are explicit

primary_sources.used_for: outward interval elementary and Bessel arithmetic

theorem_guards.hypotheses: The actual family has the recorded Q=4 log-slope enclosure, rho in [-1,1], u>0 and x>=xs>3 throughout the sharp chart.
theorem_guards.scope: Only the actual direction is transported to Q_switch; no absolute amplitude or below-switch Riccati chart is inferred.
theorem_guards.theorem: DLMF Liouville--Green recessive solution plus the pinned scalar Riccati invariant barrier

theorem_guards.hypotheses: The exact homogeneous kernel is positive, 0<=rho^2<=1 follows from the invariant barrier, and both positive kernel masses are bounded by monotone finite panels plus an analytic infinite tail.
theorem_guards.scope: The enclosure is analytic and outward; it is not a black-box numerical ODE or a sampled trajectory.

theorem_guards.hypotheses: Each downstream rational step uses complete parameter boxes, actual derivative jets through order 12, a state tube and D_13 |h|^13/13!.
theorem_guards.scope: This validates only Q_switch to Q0 and remains node-safe as a two-state calculation.
theorem_guards.theorem: Taylor theorem with whole-step coefficient and derivative majorants

theorem_guards.hypotheses: For real x>0 and real kappa, the selected K_(i*kappa)(x) solution and its x derivative are real; the full inherited kappa bracket is real.
theorem_guards.scope: The Arb imaginary intervals are numerical residue diagnostics. Real-part inclusion supplies only the lambda-zero switch and endpoint regressions.
theorem_guards.theorem: DLMF sections 10.25 and 10.29 for the real modified-Bessel equation and recurrences

theorem_guards.hypotheses: The potential and forcing masses are integrable and division is performed only after the Q0 amplitude interval excludes zero.
theorem_guards.scope: The complete selected-reference quotient tail supplies no spectrum, rigging map or RAQ.
theorem_guards.theorem: Rotating-frame variation of constants and Gronwall on Q<-4

theorem_guards.hypotheses: One inherited root bracket, two real lambda boxes, lambda zero, two precisions and two analytic-kernel panel counts are used.
theorem_guards.scope: A usable interval width is not a Gamma_1 sign, root, spectrum, quantum-gravity, physics or TOE claim.

validated_calculation.interpretation: Backward projective contraction removes the inherited Q=4 direction uncertainty before the already audited compact/tail map. The result remains an outward family enclosure and not a trajectory sample or physical claim.

summary.scope: Sharp actual direction and usable scale-free width only; sign, roots, spectrum, RAQ and physics remain null.
